scripts.build:ui: npm --prefix ../../part2/phonebook run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.cpSync('../../part2/phonebook/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true })"
scripts.deploy:full: npm run build:ui && git add . && git commit -m uibuild && git push
